basic_info.description: Nestled in the charming Sunnyside neighborhood, this traditional Craftsman style home offers the perfect balance of classic character and modern living. The flexible floor plan features 4 spacious bedrooms, with 2 on each level, allowing for multi-generational or in-law arrangements. Downstairs, the fully remodeled kitchen gleams with sleek granite countertops, complementing the fresh new bathroom. An additional separate entrance opens up possibilities for supplemental income or autonomy for older children. Step outside to a flat, open backyard - a seamless extension of the living space. Commuters will appreciate the home's prime location, with a walk score of 80 and easy access to the MUNI line and Glen Park BART station. Everyday essentials like Safeway, City College, and local parks are just minutes away, making this property a true gem in the heart of the city.
